- Rashid Al-Khatib (Staff SRE, rashid.khatib@infra-ops.io)

[11:02:14] Rashid Al-Khatib: Alert fired on Datadog: Checkout service latency P99 > 8500ms, HTTP 504 Gateway Timeout on /api/v2/orders.
[11:03:00] Kevin Zhang: Pods in production are restarting. Let me pull the current pod status:
```bash
kubectl get pods -n production -l app=checkout-service
```
Three pods are in CrashLoopBackOff with OOMKilled.

[11:04:12] Chloe Dubois: The database primary at 10.142.0.45 is hitting 100% connection capacity. Max connections is 500, active is 498.
[11:04:45] Chloe Dubois: We had a rogue background migration script holding locks. Here is the connection URI the legacy job was using:
postgresql://app_writer:K9#mQ8$vL2!xZ@10.142.0.45:5432/orders_prod
Please terminate that connection from the gateway proxy at 192.168.10.88.
